candidates.reason: Option C: retire I.14 into II.1 with a redirect and add a church-of-Alexandria entry to 451 that takes over the pre-451 shelf. It closes "No entry for the church of Alexandria, 4th-5th century" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07) and "Two Egyptian Miaphysite entries from the same year" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07) together and keeps every ID promise.

options.name: Retire I.14 into II.1 with a redirect and move its links
options.effect: Uses the unused retiredMovements mechanism (validator needs id, date, reason, redirectTo). I.14's three links (continued as II.1, broke with imperial-juridical-christianity, desert-monasticism gave rise to I.14) are retired and re-made on II.1, the first one simply dropping. The tree page, its audio entries and its index card go or redirect. totalEntries drops by one and the Deferred by Step 0 count by one. Closes "Two Egyptian Miaphysite entries from the same year" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07) only. The pre-451 shelf (Cyril's letters and Tomes, Ephesus 431, Ephesus 449, Nestorius) would land in II.1, whose window opens at 451, so those rows would be context at best. "No entry for the church of Alexandria, 4th-5th century" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07) stays open: Aksum's conversion-era entry still calls itself a child of an Alexandria no entry holds.

options.name: Keep I.14's ID and re-scope it to the pre-451 church its shelf holds
options.effect: Breaks the permanence promise. The identifiers statement says an ID is never changed or reused. It allows a rename (the old address redirects) but a rename keeps the same referent. Re-scoping makes the published ID mean a different church: its slug says 'miaphysite' (a post-451 label), its tree page has been public with post-451 text, and its three links all rest on 451-457 events (Chalcedon, Proterius, Timothy Aelurus), so each link would have to be retired and the page rewritten under the same address. Dates would move from 451-500 to a period before 451 and the era-2 'continued as' to II.1 would still need a new reason. It does close "No entry for the church of Alexandria, 4th-5th century" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07) and "Two Egyptian Miaphysite entries from the same year" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07), but by reusing an ID.

options.name: Retire I.14 into II.1 with a redirect, and add a new entry for the church of Alexandria to 451 that takes over the shelf
options.effect: Does A's retirement (links, page, narration and index handled as in A) and adds one new era-2, lane 4 Africa entry with a new ID. It takes the pre-451 rows (Cyril, Ephesus 431 and 449, Nestorius, Leo, Theodoret, Chalcedon sessions I-III). Gives Aksum's conversion-era entry the parent its text names, closing "No entry for the church of Alexandria, 4th-5th century" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07), and the new entry continues as II.1, closing "Two Egyptian Miaphysite entries from the same year" (Open-Gaps, 2026-11-07). Cost: one new entry to write and source, and a boundary to draw against alexandria-catechetical (c. 150-400, Built and Live), which already shelves about 25 Athanasius and Peter of Alexandria works as tradition; copy or leave those rows there, do not move them off a live entry. The new entry should not carry the 'Cyrilline/Miaphysite' name, which is a post-451 label.
